_comment: Binds the compiled ConfidentialPool runtime to the artifact that was reviewed. verify-pool-size.sh asserts (a) runtime <= 24576 (EIP-170, ALWAYS hard-fail) and (b) keccak(runtime) == runtime_keccak. The pool sits ~20 bytes under the limit, so ANY code or compiler change must re-measure: update this file IN THE SAME COMMIT as the change, exactly like sp1/confidential/elf-vkey-pin.json. A drifting artifact is how unaudited bytecode reaches mainnet.
